purpose: Simplified presentation UI requested by the user: one preferred project model and two genuine pretrained comparators.

models.label: Ours - lightweight SSC + attention (v4)
models.description: Your selected v4 model: sparse-sampling convolution and adaptive sparse linear attention.
models.warning: Eye and spectacle detail remains imperfect. FFHQ has clean comparison targets; QMUL has no paired clean originals. Recognizer accuracy is not a restoration percentage.

models.label: GFPGAN 1.4 (official pretrained)
training_domains: FFHQ (official pretraining; different split and procedure)
models.description: Official pretrained GFPGAN 1.4, full model output without blending.
models.warning: Shared FFHQ dataset, different training splits and budget; external pretraining overlap is not excluded. Both baselines internally resize the same supplied crop to 512 x 512, then return x4 at its original aspect ratio. No detector or extra alignment is applied. Generated details may change identity.
